name: Watch Enforcer
warning: A horn, far off, on the road. Then another, closer. The Watch is out tonight, and it's looking for you.
no_sleep: You can't sleep. Iron on the road, getting louder. They're coming for you.
arrive: Iron feet. Torches. 'There! That's the one. Bring them in breathing if you can. If you can't, don't fucking bother.'
won: The last of the iron goes down. They'll be back, and there'll be more of them. There always are.
lost: The horns fade behind you. You've lost them. For tonight.
